name: aldenard-airship-lane
about: The north-west of the game's own world painting The Three Great Continents at its high-resolution size (Aldenard: Gridania, Coerthas and Ishgard, the cloud sea's western shore, the chart's airship and dragons over the Northern Sea), read as a chart under the moon: lapis sea and silver clouds, the land's forests in sea-green, the airship's lane engraved over it in gilt from Gridania to Ishgard and on past the airship, with a branch west and the lane in from the south. Crop [0, 555, 1280, 960]: under 25% of its own area over 2-3's crop, 3-5's charter crop and 5-2's charter crop (5-2's parked recipe merlthor-strait, [0, 1200, 960, 720], is 24.6% of this crop). MR 3 round 1: a faint grey-green lift over the whole board (a glow of radius 2000) keeps the chart's black land off sRGB 0-1, where one rounding step reads 0.067 in OKLab and the converter's gate failed (critic B1); four broad tones (x 0.85, radius 110-130) quieten the bright banners and the pale cloud shore round Ishgard, Gridania, the western hold and the cloud humps, lifting F6 from 0.222 to 0.267 (UX m3). Peggle-match refit (9 October 2026): the dress is lapis and rose, a chart at dusk (the sea-green land read too close to orange for a protanope on the denser board, F9 0.091): the rose lies over the land and the lower clouds (falling away above y 200 and east of x 600), the jewel's quiet narrowed to [24, 10] so the lapis stays round the pieces, a fifth tone (x 0.8, radius 140) dims the bright cloud tops round the cloud humps, and the grade keeps less of the chart's warm parchment (warm_keep 0.12). Features added for the refit: two more cloud humps, the airship's wake, two rhumb lines off the compass rose, Gyr Abania's ridge, the Black Shroud's canopy and the western highlands.
